name: transition-inset-reveal
title: Inset (clip-path)
description: Cảnh mới mở ra từ tâm khung thành một hình chữ nhật lớn dần tới kín khung, cảnh cũ đứng yên.

moworks.author: takayu

options.ease: power2.inOut, or expo.out as the site's demo
options.reverse: true: the outgoing scene closes to the centre instead

credit.author: TakayuStudio (motion-reference)
credit.licence: No licence stated: idea and numbers only
credit.madeNote: written here from the idea and its numbers; none of the source's code

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tr-inset, written here): Incoming scene clipped inset(50 %) -> inset(0) from the centre over 500 ms easeInOutCubic (demo: expo.out); outgoing still. Optional reverse (the outgoing closes to the centre). Params: duration (0.5 s) · ease (power2.inOut / expo.out) · reverse: đóng về tâm.
